user.title: CrowdSec
user.description: Connect the CrowdSec Local API (LAPI). Create a dedicated machine for Home Assistant with `cscli machines add`, it must be validated.

data_description.url: Address of the Local API, for example {example_url}. Without a scheme, http and port 8080 are assumed.
data_description.machine_id: Name of the machine registered for Home Assistant. Only a machine (watcher) can read alerts and delete decisions, a bouncer key cannot.
data_description.password: Stored in the config entry and hidden in diagnostics.
data_description.verify_ssl: Only relevant for https. Turn off for self-signed certificates.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The LAPI rejected the stored password of machine {machine}. Check that the machine is validated (`cscli machines list`).

error.cannot_connect: The LAPI is not reachable. Check address, port and firewall.
error.invalid_auth: Machine ID or password rejected, or the machine is not validated yet.
error.invalid_response: The LAPI answered with an error.
error.invalid_url: This is not a valid address.

abort.different_machine: The machine ID differs from the configured one.

init.title: CrowdSec options
init.description: Control functions are off by default.

data_description.scan_interval: How often active bans are read. New bans are reported with this delay.
data_description.control_unban: Enables the action to delete decisions by IP address or range.
data_description.control_ban: Enables the action to add a manual ban.

control_disabled.message: This action is turned off in the options of {title}.

entry_not_found.message: CrowdSec entry not found or not loaded.

entry_ambiguous.message: Several CrowdSec instances are configured, choose one.

delete_decision.name: Delete decision
delete_decision.description: Lifts bans. A single address also lifts ranges that contain it, like `cscli decisions delete --ip`. Returns the number of deleted decisions.

config_entry_id.name: CrowdSec instance
config_entry_id.description: Only needed if several instances are configured.

ip.name: IP address or range
ip.description: Single address or range in CIDR notation.

add_decision.name: Add decision
add_decision.description: Sets a manual ban. It appears as a new ban with origin cscli.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Go duration with the units ms, s, m and h, for example 4h or 90m. Days are not supported.
